description: THE RESEARCH-AGENDA ROUTE-BY-KIND as DATA (self-improvement #5's dispatch). The meta-loop driver (domains/research_agenda.py) chains the four held self-improvement faculties (#1 perceive-gap, #2 verify, #3 acquire-knowledge, #4 extend-substrate). The ONE decision the driver must make per gap -- which FILLER handles it -- is NOT a Python if/else over graph state; it is this graph dispatch, the exact twin of seeds/composer_dispatch.json's composer_pick. Two GapRouteCue nodes map a gap KIND to its filler: a KNOWLEDGE gap (concept_graph's is_knowledge_gap true: a thin/ungrounded dimension) routes to 'acquisition' (#3 gap_driven_acquisition); a CAPABILITY gap (a behavioral faculty failure solvable by composition or specifiable as a primitive) routes to 'substrate_extension' (#4). The stored Program 'route_pick', given the gap's own kind attr (env: kind), returns the matching GapRouteCue's filler via an Argmin-by-priority over the cues whose kind Eq the gap's kind -- the same Filter/Argmin/Attr shape composer_pick uses, with Eq(cue.kind, kind) in place of In(cue.relation_head, heads). The gap's kind attr is itself written mechanically off the held faculties' own signals (gap_domain_of + is_knowledge_gap -- the learner's coverage read), the same admissible boundary read self_capability_collapse.observe_outcome makes; the ROUTE from that kind to a filler is this Program, evaluated in Rust.

microtheory.name: research_agenda_dispatch
microtheory.description: which filler faculty handles a perceived gap, keyed on its kind (knowledge -> acquisition, capability -> substrate_extension).
